scope: Source review before numerical compiler start; no GPU or numerical DLL loading

findings.issue: NVCC Make dependency parser drops the first recipe line and accepts empty/malformed existing files as a source-only closure PASS
findings.required: Strict target/RHS/continuation/escaping grammar and nonempty complete source binding, adversarial CPU fixtures

findings.issue: FREEZE.json is read into memory but not itself held deny-write or pre/post digest checked
findings.required: Hold manifest file and independently bind observed digest before and after build

findings.issue: Any existing file under build output is accepted as generated input
findings.required: Constrain generated inputs to per-invocation declared outputs and retain generator/invocation provenance

findings.issue: Python executable hash is not a full Python runtime/stdlib freeze; Windows runtime and hardware are also outside copied codegen toolchain
findings.required: Record precise scope; do not call all orchestration/OS components immutable

resolution: Native owner notified before input freeze; later corrected source and receipts must supersede these preparation-only findings
